snippet.title: Beast of Reincarnation - Gameplay Overview | Xbox Developer Direct 2026
snippet.description:
Learn more about Beast of Reincarnation, the 'one-person, one-dog action RPG" from Pokemon developer Game Freak. During the Developer_Direct, we learned more about the journey of Emma and Koo in 4026 AD and the gameplay fans can expect, which fuses Emma's fast-paced katana action and Koo's powerful skills that are triggered via a command-based system. Beast of Reincarnation will be released on Xbox Series X/S, PlayStation 5, and PC in Summer 2026.

#IGN #Gaming #Xbox
